newsitem.title: USA: Indiana approves PSI Energy rate increase.
newsitem.headline: Indiana approves PSI Energy rate increase.

text.p: The Indiana Utility Regulatory Commission said Wednesday it approved an electric rate increase requested by PSI Energy Inc to cover fuel costs incurred from July to September, 1997.
The commission said PSI Energy, a subsidiary of Cinergy Corp, could collect about 3.8 percent more from its customers over the three-month period.

PSI Energy's request is part of a regulatory procedure that allows Indiana's electric utilities to raise or lower rates for a three-month period based upon changes in the price of fuel used to generate electricity.
PSI Energy serves about 632,000 cusotmers in 69 counties throughout Indiana.
